newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar settles unchanged in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar settles unchanged in thin trade.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures closed unchanged as prices consolidated recent gains and many players opted out of the market to contemplate their next move, market sources said.
The May contract closed flat at 11.00 cents while the deferred months ended 0.01 lower to 0.04 firmer.
Volume was estimated at 12,487 lots compared to Thursday's official 15,942 lots.

After rallying to a recent high of 11.06 cents basis May, the market failed to follow its recent pattern and slipped back to the lower end of the trading range. Some analysts said this was a bullish signal, particularly ahead of the May contract's expiry in three weeks.
The last trading day for the contract is April 30.
The expiry of May options may keep prices close to 11.00 cents in the near term, trading sources said, as open interest in the 11.00 calls and 10.50 puts remains high.
Open interest in May rose 90 lots to 60,585 lots, as of Thursday's close.
Support was pegged at Tuesday's low of 10.78 cents basis May.
